reasons.plausibility: The mechanism of lattice distortion and short-range ordering impeding dislocation motion is well-grounded in current understanding of strengthening phenomena in high-entropy alloys.
reasons.testability: The proposed systematic composition changes, microstructural characterization, and direct mechanical testing create a clear and feasible path to confirm or refute the hypothesis.
reasons.usefulness: This work helps clarify a fundamental strengthening mechanism and provides a concrete experimental approach to guide alloy design for enhanced mechanical properties.
